BAM-BAM'S SYSTEMS PARK
Explore • Develop • Apply • Assess • Reflect
A GRAPHICAL STUDY OF SYSTEMS

BUILD A
SYSTEMS PARK

Every path in Bam-Bam's park is a function. Whenever two paths meet, that intersection is a solution to the system. Your job is to explore how graphs behave, develop your eye for intersections, design a park using systems, and prove what you know on a scored assessment.

PARK RANGER • BAM-BAM
“Follow the paths. The answer is where they meet.” — Bam-Bam

Student Check-In

Enter your name before beginning.

Your Mission

Complete all five phases. Your park design, assessment score, and reflection will appear in the final report.

Rule: Solve systems graphically. Do not use substitution or elimination.
🐾
PHASE 01 • EXPLORE

What does a solution look like?

Move the sliders. Change the function families. Watch how the number and location of intersections change.

Before revealing: predict 0, 1, 2, or more intersections.
Explore question: What changes the number of solutions: the function family, the transformations, or both?
🔎
PHASE 02 • DEVELOP

Train your intersection eye

Now the graphs are chosen for you. Click every visible solution. Use hints only when needed.

GUIDED PRACTICE 1 OF 6

Warm-Up

Bam-Bam tip: Scan left to right and count each meeting point once.
🌳
PHASE 03 • APPLY • PARK DESIGN STUDIO

Design Bam-Bam's Systems Park

Each park feature must be created from a system of two graphs. Choose a system tool, solve it graphically, and then click in the park to place that feature. Your design must satisfy all four park rules.

Reflection
